statement: You are given an array prices, where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i.
You may make at most two trades, each a buy followed by a later sell. You can hold at most one share at a time, so the second trade must start after the first one ends.
Return the largest total profit you can make.

examples.explanation: Buy at 0 and sell at 3 (+3), then buy at 1 and sell at 4 (+3), for 6 in total.
The price only falls, so making no trade is best.
